title: As You Like It Section 1: Objectives, Vocabulary, Warmer, Story Summary, Literary Extract, and Reading for Detail Activities
summary: This page outlines the teaching plan for Section 1 of As You Like It, covering objectives (read for pleasure, develop vocabulary), key vocabulary words, a warmer activity recalling the play, reading the story summary and extract, and detail-focused exercises where students order events from the text.

title: Vocabulary Answers for As You Like It Section 1 and Predictive Writing Activity
summary: This page provides answer keys for vocabulary exercises testing archaic English words such as wilt, thou, thrice, and thy. It also introduces a writing task where students discuss in small groups and then individually write their predictions about what will happen to the characters next.

title: As You Like It Section 2: Objectives, Vocabulary, Warmer, Story Summary, and Literary Extract Reading Activities
summary: This page presents the lesson plan for Section 2 with new vocabulary (overheard, good looks, shepherd, beloved). It includes a group discussion warmer, reading the story summary about two men in the forest, a gist-reading activity of the extract, and comprehension questions with multiple-choice answers.

title: Summary Completion and Play Scene Writing Activities for As You Like It Section 2
summary: This page contains a summary completion exercise where students fill in missing words using modern English versions, followed by a creative writing task. Students work in groups to imagine Rosalind's reaction to Silvius' speech and write an original scene for the play.

title: As You Like It Section 3: Objectives, Vocabulary, Warmer, Story Summary, and True-False Reading Exercises
summary: This page outlines Section 3 lesson objectives and vocabulary (verse, indescribable, cure). It includes a group warmer, the story summary about Rosalind and Orlando's conversation, gist reading of extracts with true/false statements, and comprehension activities about character actions.

title: Sentence Ordering and Play Scene Writing Activities for As You Like It Section 3
summary: This page presents an ordering exercise where students arrange extract sentences correctly and compare their sequence with the textbook version, identifying key words. It concludes with a creative task where students imagine Rosalind revealing herself to Orlando and write that scene in groups.

title: As You Like It Section 4: Objectives, Vocabulary, Warmer, Story Summary, and Event Ordering Exercises
summary: This page covers Section 4 lesson planning with extensive vocabulary (confess, executioner, cowardly, tyrants, fake). It features a group warmer, reading the story summary, gist reading where students order events from the extract, and comprehension questions about characters' actions.

title: Vocabulary Answers and Creative Letter Writing Activity for As You Like It Section 4
summary: This page provides answer keys for archaic vocabulary exercises including thee, 'tis, mine, and tell'st. It also introduces a writing task where students imagine they are Phoebe and compose a short letter to Ganymede confessing love, working individually then sharing in small groups.
